name: The Price of Recovery
source:
A (parody?) fangame for Gatobob's The Price of Flesh.

Be warned that The Price of Flesh is an +18 horror survival VN with porn elements. The Price of Recovery is clean, but follows one of the endings on Derek's path, so it is recommended to complete that path first. The "parody?" comes in due to the change of atmosphere from horror-filled situation to just getting a meal at a dinner with a friend you made during that life-death situation.

Tom has been thinking of you ever since you saved him in the desert. During dinner, it's up to you to decide if you want to share those feelings or inspire him to share his. Things aren't without your trauma, though.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230907103539/https://garbledmess.itch.io/the-price-of-recovery]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款（恶搞？）同人游戏，改编自Gatobob的《The Price of Flesh》。

请注意：《The Price of Flesh》是一款18岁以上游玩的恐怖生存视觉小说，含色情元素。《The Price of Recovery》内容健康，但承接Derek路线的某个结局，所以建议先完成该路线。之所以说是“恶搞？”，是因为游戏氛围从恐怖的处境转变为与一位在生死关头结识的朋友共进晚餐。

自从你在沙漠中救下Tom之后，他就一直想着你。晚餐时，你可以决定是否分享这份感情，或鼓励他表露心意。不过，你的创伤仍会影响这一切。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230907103539/https://garbledmess.itch.io/the-price-of-recovery]Itch.io[/url]]
